# AAS Documentation Rules (Diátaxis + Sphinx)

Documentation is not a side quest.

## Diátaxis structure
- Tutorials: `docs/tutorials/`
- How-to guides: `docs/how-to/`
- Explanation: `docs/explanation/`
- Reference: `docs/reference/`

## Conventions
- Use `.rst`.
- Each folder has an `index.rst` with a toctree.
- Keep pages small and linkable. Prefer many small pages over one mega-scroll.
